row.title: Merging a moving main with a prefer-ours strategy left the seed Worker calling a list it no longer defined
row.body: Three merges of the lane's commits used -X ours and kept older versions of files main had since changed (the visibility gate, the cold-start check, a claim probe). Only running every suite and the regeneration step with its warnings found them; tests pass on the repaired tree. For a branch the lane also writes to, merge without a side preference and resolve by reading both.

title: Merging a moving main with a prefer-ours strategy left the seed Worker calling a list it no longer defined
